verse.verse_1: GLORIFY THE NAME of your Lord, most high,
verse.verse_5: Then reduces them to rusty rubbish.
verse.verse_6: We shall make you recite (the Qur'an) so that you will not forget it,
verse.verse_7: Unless God may please. He knows the visible and knows what is hidden.
verse.verse_8: We shall take you slowly towards ease.
verse.verse_9: So remind them if reminder is profitable:
verse.verse_11: Only the wretch will turn aside,
verse.verse_12: Who will burn in the terrible Fire,
verse.verse_13: In which he will neither die nor live.
verse.verse_14: Surely he will succeed who grows in goodness,
verse.verse_15: And recites the name of his Lord and serves with devotion.
verse.verse_16: But no, you prefer the life of the world,
verse.verse_17: Though the life to come is better and abiding.
verse.verse_18: This is surely in the earlier Books,
verse.verse_19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
